answer_1.quote: We propose a scalable framework, alternating ELABoration and answer predictOR (ELABOR), consisting of two interacting modules: an elaboration generator and an answer predictor. ... The elaboration refers to additional context describing some background knowledge about the question.
answer_1.outputs: Free‑text elaborations (background knowledge) generated for each question

answer_4.quote: The annotation task was carried out in Amazon Mechanical Turk. We restrict annotators to those located in English‑speaking countries ... The workers are then asked to evaluate the SELECT and DISCARD elaborations by choosing 1‑out‑of‑3 choices: helpful, neutral, and harmful. ... We also evaluate factuality, relevance, and helpfulness of the generated elaborations.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate each elaboration for helpfulness (helpful/neutral/harmful) and rate factuality, relevance, and overall helpfulness of the text.
